info.title: Proxy API
info.description: Card issuance and transaction management API for AI agents and automation. Proxy enables customers to issue virtual cards with policy-based spending controls.

tags.name: Customers
tags.description: Manage customers who own agents and cards

tags.name: Agents
tags.description: Manage autonomous agents that can spend on behalf of customers

tags.name: Cards
tags.description: Manage virtual spending cards with policy controls

tags.name: Intents
tags.description: Pre-transaction declarations for spend approval workflows

tags.name: Access Events
tags.description: Card credential access grants with attestation windows

tags.name: Balances
tags.description: View customer balances and funding instructions

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all customers.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page of results

get.description: Retrieve a customer by ID.

delete.description: Soft-delete a customer. Sets status to deleted.

get.description: Retrieve the balance information for a customer.
Retrieve deposit address and instructions for funding a customer account.
Retrieve a paginated list of agents, optionally filtered by customer.

post.description: Create a new agent or register an existing one by externalId (idempotent by externalId).

get.description: Retrieve an agent by ID.

patch.description: Update agent details, status, limits, or policy.

delete.description: Soft-delete an agent. Sets status to disabled.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of cards, optionally filtered by customer or agent.

post.description: Issue a new virtual or physical card for a customer.

get.description: Retrieve card details by ID.

patch.description: Update card status, limits, billing, or policy.

delete.description: Cancel/close a card. The card will no longer be usable for transactions.

get.description: Retrieve intents associated with a card.

post.description: Declare an intent to spend before accessing card credentials.

get.description: Retrieve access events (credential access grants) for a card.

post.description: Request access to card credentials. Returns granted/denied status based on policy evaluation.
Retrieve sensitive card details (PAN, CVV) after policy evaluation. Requires intent if policy mandates it.

get.description: Retrieve the resolved policy, spend limits, TTL, and cooldown status for a card.

post.description: Temporarily freeze a card. The card cannot be used for transactions until unfrozen.
Replace a virtual card with new credentials (new PAN/CVV).

get.description: Retrieve an intent by ID.

post.description: Approve a pending_approval intent, allowing the associated transaction to proceed.

get.description: Retrieve policy findings/analysis for an intent.
Retrieve an access event by ID.
Retrieve a paginated list of transactions, optionally filtered by customer, agent, or card.
Retrieve a transaction by ID.
Retrieve all configured webhook subscriptions.

post.description: Create a new webhook subscription or update an existing one (if id is provided).

get.description: Retrieve a webhook subscription by ID.
Retrieve KYC applications for a customer.

post.description: Submit a new KYC application for a customer.

get.description: Retrieve a KYC application by ID.

patch.description: Update a KYC application with additional information.

get.description: Retrieve a list of disputes.
Retrieve a dispute by ID.

post.description: Evaluate whether a proposed spend would be approved based on current policy rules.

BearerAuth.description: API key authentication. Include your API key in the Authorization header as `Bearer <api_key>`.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 50)

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Unique key for idempotent requests (24-hour cache)

Unauthorized.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid API key

requireIntent.description: Require an intent before card access

autoApproveBelow.description: Auto-approve intents below this amount (in cents)

attestationWindowMinutes.description: Minutes that access credentials remain valid

lockToFirstMerchant.description: Lock card to first merchant used

interval.description: Limit interval (e.g., daily, weekly, monthly, all_time, per_authorization)

singleUseConsumedAt.description: Timestamp when single-use card was used

customerId.description: Customer ID to issue card for

agentId.description: Agent ID to assign card to

accessEventId.description: Access event ID for this retrieval

intentId.description: Intent ID to associate with this access

url.description: Webhook endpoint URL (required for new webhooks)

secret.description: Custom signing secret (auto-generated if not provided)
